items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The owner of Storyville is, was, or is because he is still alive, George Wein, who organized festivals in the summer here in New York and outside New York as well - the Cool Jazz Festivals as they are called.

ctx.x: That was more than thirty years ago. More than thirty years. The owner of Storyville is, was, or is because he is still alive, George Wein, who organized festivals in the summer here in New York and outside New York as well - the Cool Jazz Festivals as they are called.
